description:
Documentation audit (2026-04-01) found several docs referencing deprecated
commands, stale module paths, or outdated information:

1. docs/guides/dataframe-comparison.md - documents deprecated
   compare-dataframes command. Has deprecation notice but entire file
   still walks through old workflow.

2. docs/reference/cli/tuning.md - still references create-sample-tuning
   (hidden/deprecated in code). Should only document tuning init.

3. docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md - may reference an
   outdated execution model. PowerRunExecutor actually exists at
   benchbox.utils.execution_manager (line 148). Verify doc accuracy
   against current API rather than assuming it's wrong.

4. docs/performance/dataframe-benchmarks.md - verify module paths.
   Note: benchbox.core.dataframe.profiling.DataFrameProfiler actually
   EXISTS (line 439). Check each path individually rather than assuming
   all are stale.

5. docs/development/roadmap.md - platform count (28) is slightly stale;
   codebase has 27 concrete adapters (not 40+ as previously claimed).
   Verify exact count before updating. Phase 1 completion status not
   updated.

6. docs/development/adding-dataframe-platform.md - doesn't mention
   ExpressionFamilyAdapter / PandasFamilyAdapter base classes. Code
   examples use outdated query patterns.

verifications.command: grep -rn 'compare-dataframes\|create-sample-tuning\|df-tuning' docs/ || echo 'PASS: no deprecated commands'
verifications.description: No deprecated compare-dataframes or create-sample-tuning commands in docs

verifications.command: grep -c 'ExpressionFamilyAdapter\|PandasFamilyAdapter' docs/development/adding-dataframe-platform.md | xargs -I{} test {} -ge 2 && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL: base classes missing'

work_units.summary: Rewrite or remove dataframe-comparison.md - compare-dataframes deprecated
Verify and update power-run docs against current executor API
Verify and update dataframe-benchmarks.md module paths
Update roadmap.md with current platform count and phase status
Update adding-dataframe-platform.md with current adapter base classes
